title: LRT-2 back to normal operations after damaged catenary wire
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The train lines of Light Rail Transit 2 (LRT-2) resumed full operations on Wednesday after a lightning struck and severed a catenary wire at its Antipolo station on Tuesday…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The train lines of Light Rail Transit 2 (LRT-2) resumed full operations on Wednesday after a lightning struck and severed a catenary wire at its Antipolo station on Tuesday afternoon, according to the Light Rail Transit Authority (LRTA). READ: LRT-2 on limited operations: Recto – Santolan, vice versa The LRT 2 was on limited operations due to the incident where train operations were limited between Recto Station and Santolan Station and vice versa, as of 4:30 p.m. on Tuesday. This left train passengers stranded in train stations as they looked for alternative modes of transportation. In an advisory […]...
